title: LLM isolation X19c: profiles name the capabilities a seat needs, and the router refuses a seat that no routed driver can serve
summary: The router picks a driver by family and tier only. A seat that needs a tool, such as edit or shell, can route to a driver that lacks it, and nothing refuses the route. X9 adds the manifest capabilities field. Spec: docs/architecture/llm-isolation.md §28 (capability negotiation); ADR-0154 rule 23.
fix: Each profile names its needed capabilities. The router keeps only the drivers whose manifest capabilities hold each one. When no driver in the chain qualifies, it returns a routing refusal with the missing capability. It never downgrades in silence.
acceptance: RED first: a fixture profile with needs ["edit"] routes to a fake manifest without the edit capability, and no refusal happens
The router refuses the seat with a routing error that names the missing capability
Today's routing is unchanged for each tracked profile: evolve cli-routing explain is byte-identical before and after
Changed functions at 100% coverage; spec §28 and the cliroute package note updated
